description: Evaluates whether a city, county, market, or project area can support a target megawatt load by checking substation headroom, competing queue requests, and active campus developments. Use when comparing markets or screening regional grid capacity.

location.description: City, county, or regional market to screen (e.g. 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA', 'Dallas, TX').

max_radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around the target location (e.g. 35).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

query.description: Free-text location or project query (e.g. 'Columbus, OH' or 'Stargate Abilene').

radius_miles.description: Alias for search radius in miles (e.g. 25).

required_voltage_kv.description: Minimum substation interconnection voltage in kilovolts (e.g. 230, 345, 500).

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

target_mw.description: Target electrical capacity to screen in megawatts (e.g. 250).

name: screen_regional_capacity

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.

title: Screen Regional Power Capacity
